capabilities: render tag content inline with a tag-page code block
create dedicated tag pages from a command
scope pages to nested tags with wildcards
customize the tag page directory and title template
sort pulled lines by date and position reference links
extras: Generated content is embedded via a code block so user-written notes around it are preserved; a cleanup command removes legacy generated content after migration.
problem: Obsidian's tag features only list which notes contain a tag; there is no single page that consolidates the actual tagged lines and lets you annotate around them.
summary: Tag page plugin that generates and updates dedicated Markdown pages for tags, pulling in lines that reference each tag via a tag-page code block.
